description: Spread history for ONE watched topic — the time-series of every alert that fired for that topic over the past N hours. Use to chart how a specific cross-venue mispricing evolved (e.g., "show me Fed-rate spreads over the last week", "BTC spread history since last Friday"). Topic must be one of the watched topics — call arb_watchlist to enumerate.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours. Default 72, max 720.

topic.description: Watchlist topic key like "fed", "btc", "cpi", "gdp", "sp500", "recession", "2028_president". Lowercase; matches arb_watchlist.

name: arb_topic_history
title: Arb Topic History
